nodes.name: MANEF document converter
nodes.notes: JSON ↔ MANEF Markdown with the same canonical document core as the editor. Returns {document, source, format} per item and retains item linking. Markdown must contain exactly one manef-diagram-json fenced block. Plain Mermaid alone cannot preserve a complete document.
